comment: Identical architectures made optimizer progress the main discriminator. K1001 and K1002 supported AdamW E first, low-rate Adam C above low-rate Adagrad A, and higher-rate Adagrad D above A. The close B–D comparison was less certain: their nominal displacement estimates differ by only 25%, so K1012 cautioned against mechanically preferring D. K1070’s short-budget classification preference for RMSprop supported B ahead of D, though it is not direct RMSprop–Adagrad evidence. K1005 kept decay and beta differences secondary in this undertrained regime. The gold confirms this ordering for the given recipe, without establishing a new general rule.
